technique_name: Describe the concept of modular programming
description: Modular programming is an approach to software development that subdivides a system into smaller, self-contained components known as modules. Each module is responsible for a specific functionality of the system, and they are loosely coupled, meaning that changes to one module may not require changes to other modules.
